name: Chloe Goldstein
source: The only daughter of Robert Goldstein, she is a rich, well-cared young lady who grew quieter and more forlorn through the years, even more so as a tragedy hits after the next. Shouldering an unbearably heavy burden, she became more and more reclusive.
